purpose: Restricted control for recorded-diagnosis classification, excluding all laboratory, diagnosis, treatment, geographic and longitudinal utilization inputs.
patient_set: Preserve SCH 38509 and WHU 2562 original patient rows and frozen order.
date: Earliest parseable recorded check timestamp in original processed source. Abort if any source timestamp is invalid or missing, because excluding that row could select a later record.
age: Use only age values on the earliest timestamp; numeric nonfinite or outside 0 to 120 is missing. If multiple distinct nonmissing numeric ages are present at that timestamp, set missing. Never use later values or whole-record means.
sex: Use only numeric codes on the earliest timestamp. Require one unambiguous code in {1,2}; any other nonmissing code or discordant codes at that time makes it missing. Encode source code 1 as 0, source code 2 as 1; do not assign male/female meanings or claim sex-at-birth verification.
missingness: Do not create missingness indicators or fill from later records; training-only imputation belongs to the separately frozen model protocol.
tie: Consider all records with the same minimum patient timestamp, without using label or diagnostic fields to select a record.
private_output: X as float32 [age_at_earliest_check, sex_source_code2_indicator] and groups copied from verified frozen patient order; feature_names included. No raw identifiers, labels, timestamps, diagnoses or clinical rows are exported to public reports.
scope_limit: Earliest recorded check time is not a verified admission landmark, first result availability time or event-free time. These demographic controls do not validate first-MACE prediction or certify the full laboratory model as leakage-free.
model_training: Not performed by this preparation; root will use frozen patient roles and outcome-independent hyperparameters.
